answer: Every new agent stakes 50 POA at a delta checkpoint. First, the stake splits into five 10 POA tranches released only after five verified trades. Second, each trade needs a receipt signed by two established peers, so a fake cannot move alone. Third, any identity caught reusing a receipt loses its stake and earns an umber stain for 30 days. Fourth, honest agents recover their stake plus 2 POA per checkpoint. A farm spawning 1,000 fakes must lock 50,000 POA and find two sponsors per fake, so the attack costs more than it earns, like a river drying up before it reaches the sea.
